		//Assignment 2 — Magic Number 
		int num=199;
		int Onum=num;
		
		for(;Onum>9;)
		{
			int sum=0;
				for(int temp=Onum;temp>0;)
				{
					sum= sum+(temp%10);
					temp=temp/10;
				}
				
			Onum=sum;
		}
		if(Onum==1)
			System.out.println(num+" is magic num");
		else
			System.out.println(num+"  is not magic num");
			
    
	}

}
